scope: padding does not extend the ps block (it stays 28 bits for V=1) and the client exits during the run

measurement.note: the timing is the reverse of the V=23 case: here the ps block stops at its natural 28 bits even though we appended zeros, and the client process exited before t=35

reading: the ps block length is driven by its own content (landing index), not by the padding after it - so padding cannot be used to 'extend' it
the client exited during this run, which is the second time a ps-carrying body ended the process
the most plausible cause is that the playerstate we produce contains values the game logic later uses (e.g. a garbage float from codec -58) and the client crashes on them
next: avoid the float codecs (-58/-100) in the delta and carry values only through fixed-width fields
that means landing on an index whose codec is a fixed width, and encoding every field before it with the zero-flag form only
